title: Pack manifest
description: The manifest.json of a stack pack in packs/<id>/. Packs are data loaded at runtime; the core knows no stack.

id.description: Pack identifier; it must match the directory name.

detect.description: Signs that a repository uses the stack. The pack applies when any of them matches.

items.description: One sign: a file matching path, which contains the text when contains is set.

path.description: Glob of a file or directory.

languages.description: Languages the pack reviews. Changed files in other languages are listed as not verified.

id.description: Language identifier, as in the language of its lexer table and in work packages.

extensions.description: File name extensions of the language, with the leading dot. The manifest is the only place that maps extensions to a language.

lexer.description: Lexer table of the language, relative to the pack directory.

symbols.description: How the public declarations of the language are found in its tokens, to compare the API of a file at base and at head. Absent: the language declares no symbols that are compared. The core knows no language: every word and bracket comes from here.

packageKeyword.description: Word that starts the package statement at top level, followed by the dotted package name.

declarations.description: Words that start a declaration, with the kind of symbol they declare. Words before the declaration word on the same declaration are its modifiers.

word.description: The declaration word, for example fun or class.

kind.description: function: has a parameter list; property: a value; type: a type whose body holds members.

typedMembers.description: Members of a type body declared without a declaration word, as <modifiers> <type> <name>: a function when the name is followed by the parameter list, a property when it is followed by one of ends. Absent: every declaration has a declaration word.

ends.description: Punctuation that ends the name of a property, for example = and ;.

hidingModifiers.description: Modifiers that hide a declaration and everything inside it from other modules, for example private and internal.

publicModifiers.description: Modifiers that make a declaration public, for example public and protected.

publicByDefault.description: Whether a declaration without a hiding or public modifier is public.

publicMembersIn.description: Declaration words of types whose members are public without a public modifier, for example interface in Java.

annotation.description: Punctuation that starts an annotation, for example @. Annotations before a declaration are skipped, with their arguments.

qualifiers.description: Punctuation between a receiver type and the name of an extension, for example . and ?.; the name is the word after the last one.

typeParameters.description: Brackets of type parameters and type arguments, which are skipped. A token made only of closing characters closes once per character.

parameterType.description: Punctuation between a parameter name and its type, for example :; the name is the word right before it. Absent: the name is the last word of the parameter before its default.

parameterDefault.description: Punctuation that starts the default value of a parameter, for example =. Absent: parameters have no defaults.

profileDetect.description: Signs of a profile, tried in order when neither the repository configuration nor the cascade decides it (a repository that another change request of the cascade depends on is a library). The first matching sign decides. Every profile named must be in profiles.

items.description: One sign: a file matching path, which contains the text when contains is set.

path.description: Glob of a file or directory.

defaultProfile.description: Profile used when no sign of profileDetect matches; it must be in profiles. Absent: the first of profiles.

dimensions.description: Axes along which the repository varies within the stack, for example the UI toolkit. Each one has a value per repository, set by the repository configuration or detected from its files; rules can depend on it. The core treats dimensions as data.

id.description: Dimension identifier, the key of the repository configuration and of the conditions of rules. It cannot be profile.

detect.description: Signs of a value, used when the repository configuration does not set the dimension.

items.description: One sign: a file matching path, which contains the text when contains is set, shows the value.

value.description: Value the sign shows; it must be in values.

path.description: Glob of a file or directory.

default.description: Value used when no sign matches; it must be in values.

combined.description: Value used when signs of more than one value match; it must be in values. Absent: the value of the first sign that matches.

fileDimensions.description: Axes along which the changed files vary, for example the platform of a source set. Each changed file has one value per file dimension: that of the first map entry whose glob matches it, else the default. Rules depend on it like on a dimension, evaluated per file. When several active packs declare the same file dimension, the one with the highest priority decides; equal priorities with different mappings are an error.

id.description: Dimension identifier, the key of the conditions of rules. It cannot be profile nor the id of a dimension of the pack.

map.description: Entries tried in order; the first whose path matches the file gives its value.

value.description: Value of the files; it must be in values.

default.description: Value of the files no entry matches; it must be in values.

priority.description: Order of the active packs: the higher wins a file dimension several packs declare.

rules.description: Rules catalog file, relative to the pack directory.

templates.description: Report and comment templates, relative to the pack directory.

noise.description: Globs of changed files listed as noise and not reviewed.

testFiles.description: Globs of test sources. Rules skip them unless they say otherwise.

generatedMarkers.description: Texts that mark a file as generated when found in its first lines.

dimensionId.description: Identifier of a dimension or of one of its values: lowercase words joined by hyphens.

glob.description: Path glob with forward slashes: '*' matches within a segment, '**' matches any number of segments.

lexerBracket.description: A single punctuation character: not blank, not a letter, digit or underscore.

marker.description: Punctuation of the language, without spaces.

packId.description: Stack pack identifier, for example android or kotlin-multiplatform.

profile.description: Kind of repository, which selects the default criteria.

relativePath.description: Relative path with forward slashes, without empty, '.' or '..' segments.

word.description: A word of the language: a letter or underscore, then letters, digits or underscores.
